Patients will be placed in the lateral decubitus position during the procedure. The level of the block will be evaluated by the patient's ability to move their lower extremities. The patient will be asked to move their legs and to report the level of the block. The level of the block will be defined as the highest dermatome at which the patient is able to move their lower extremities. The patient will be asked to rate the pain during the procedure using the visual numeric scale (VNS). The VNS is a 10-point scale, with 0 being no pain and 10 being the worst possible pain. The patient will be asked to rate the pain during the procedure at 5-minute intervals. The patient will be asked to rate the pain at the end of the procedure. The patient will be asked to rate the pain 24 hours after the procedure. The patient will be asked to rate the pain at the end of the study.
